stemMd: Two atoms are isotopes of the same element. Which quantity must be equal?
explanationMd: Element identity is fixed by proton number. Isotopes preserve that number while differing in neutrons, so mass-related and nuclear properties can differ.

distractorRationale.a: Different neutron counts give different mass numbers.
distractorRationale.b: Some isotopes may be stable and others radioactive.
